title: What Is Semiconductor Die Bonding? An Illustrated Guide to Attaching Chips to Substrates, Bonding Methods, Misalignment, and Voids
excerpt: Die bonding is a back-end process that attaches semiconductor chips, cut apart by dicing, to a substrate or lead frame. This illustrated beginner's guide covers pickup, alignment, attaching with adhesive, solder, or sintering, quality points such as misalignment, tilt, and voids, and the terms you will see in job postings.
